# HOI4 Portrait Workflows 3.0.0

This release rebuilds the project around FLUX.2 Klein 9B with a
beginner-friendly, compact workflow pack and smart installers.

## Highlights

- **Four default workflows**: source (three candidates), text-to-image,
  processing-only, and a new **batch** workflow that turns a folder of photos
  into game-ready portraits in one queue.
- Choose **GGUF** (8–16 GB VRAM), **FP8** (16–20 GB), or **full** (24+ GB);
  the installers
  detect your VRAM and pre-check the recommended variant.
- **One advanced sampler card** per generation branch: CFG, guidance, seed,
  steps, **sampling algorithm**, scheduler, denoise, and partial-step
  controls, tuned to Euler/simple at CFG 1, guidance 1, and **4 steps**.
  Sampling is live in the editor.
- **Comparison row** below the LoRA cards: ESRGAN source, restoration pass,
  and the three 156×210 finals side by side, plus source/ESRGAN previews.
- **HOI4-ready DDS output** — every workflow saves 156×210 **DXT5 (BC3, no
  mipmaps)** files that drop straight into `gfx/portraits`.
- **Beginner setup guide** notes with model folder paths (emojis and all),
  sampler explanations, restoration rationale, and the exact prompt
  `make this portrait hoi4_portrait style`.
- **Windows installer wizard** with VRAM detection and multi-select variant /
  GGUF-quantization menus; RunPod installers default to full and
  accept `--variant` / `--gguf-quants`.

## Assets

- `HOI4-Portrait-Workflows-v3.0.0.zip` — model-free ZIP
- `HOI4-Portrait-Workflows-v3.0.0-windows-x64.exe` — VRAM-guided installer
- `HOI4-Portrait-RunPod.tar.gz` — RunPod runtime archive

See [`docs/local-install.md`](docs/local-install.md) for exact storage and VRAM
requirements per variant.
